speaker: Doctor
text:
The pelvic ultrasound showing multiple ovarian cysts with a normal uterus is highly characteristic of the "testicular feminization" pattern seen in disorders of sexual development, specifically Androgen Insensitivity Syndrome (AIS). However, the presence of clitoromegaly at birth is inconsistent with complete AIS. Does the patient have any breast development, and do you have any results for an Anti-Müllerian Hormone (AMH) level or a karyotype (chromosome analysis)?

DIAGNOSIS READY: 46,XY Partial Androgen Insensitivity Syndrome
